parameters.content:
## Code à Cuisine – error notification

Set this workflow as *Error workflow* in the settings of the recipe generator. Then every failed run sends an email with the failed node, the message and a link to the execution.

Setup: SMTP credential **"SMTP account"**, sender and recipient address in the email node.
